projects.title: Procura
projects.subtitle: Hierarchical RAG for tender documents
points: Parses and normalises long, unstructured RFP and tender PDFs with Docling, then splits them into parent–child sections.
Keeps every LLM answer grounded in — and traceable to — the exact part of the source document it came from.
Stores structured document data in PostgreSQL via SQLAlchemy behind a FastAPI backend for fast, traceable lookups across large document sets.
projects.note: Built during the Data Analytics & AI/ML internship at Business Intelligence Professionals — taken from idea to working prototype.

projects.title: SkillSync
projects.subtitle: Peer skill-matching platform
points: Designed a 9-table MySQL schema with key, UNIQUE, ENUM and cascade constraints, plus composite indexes on frequent query paths.
Encoded matching rules in the database: 5 stored procedures, a cursor-based routine, a trigger that auto-creates a match on acceptance, and a stored function for dashboard analytics.
Migrated the backend from Flask to a FastAPI REST API with Pydantic validation and bcrypt + JWT authentication.
projects.note: Matches students by course and topic strengths.

projects.title: S.I.N.G.L.E
projects.subtitle: Text-to-image diffusion model
points: Built a DDPM text-to-image pipeline conditioned on CLIP embeddings.
Added classifier-free guidance to improve prompt alignment.
Benchmarked DDPM vs. DDIM samplers on output quality against inference speed.
projects.note: Built with the ACM-SNIoE AI/ML team.
